footer.noEndorsement: An independent project. No institutional endorsement is implied.

divisions.lead: Lumenary Scientia teaches the sciences, free and open source for ever. Lumenary Lingua teaches languages. Lumenary Prep prepares learners for exams, as a paid service.
divisions.scientiaText: No accounts, no advertising and no paid tiers, now and always. Every subject runs from first steps to the frontier, in first-draft lessons awaiting human review. More sciences will follow, built the same way.
divisions.linguaText: Each language is taught through one the learner already knows. The first two courses are open, from A1 to C2: Spanish taught in English, and English taught in Spanish. More pairs will follow, starting with the world’s most widely spoken languages.
divisions.prepText: Courses for admissions tests, English-language tests and professional exams, built from each exam’s official sources. One price per course, paid once, for lifetime access. Paying for Prep is never needed to use Scientia.
